parameters.name: transactionDate
parameters.description:
DO NOT use the format provided in the coding playground output.
    Fields in this query param must be transformed according to the rules explained below.
    For example, in order to fetch the information for past 7 days:
1. Form your object first
```json
{
  "operator": "@in_past_days",
  "value": 7
}
```

2. Then encode it to sanitized URL (see the code example written in JS below)
```js
encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({"operator": "@in_past_days", "value": 7}))
```

3. The final query param structure should be looked like
```
transactionDate=%7B%22operator%22%3A%22%40in_past_days%22%2C%22value%22%3A7%7D
```

value.description:
List of available date operators:
  - `@in_future` - boolean value,
    Example: `{ "operator": "@in_future", "value": true }`
  - `@in_past` - boolean value,
    Example: `{ "operator": "@in_past", "value": true }`
  - `@in_next_days` - numeric value,
    Example: `{ "operator": "@in_next_days", "value": 2 }`
  - `@is_after_days` - numeric value,
    Example: `{ "operator": "@is_after_days", "value": 2 }`
  - `@in_past_days` - numeric value,
    Example: `{ "operator": "@in_past_days", "value": 2 }`
  - `@is_before_days` - numeric value,
    Example: `{ "operator": "@is_before_days", "value": 2 }`
  - `@on` - Date string value,
    Example: `{ "operator": "@on", "value": "2022-07-03T12:00:00+03:00" }`
  - `@between` - array of two Date string values,
    Example: `{ "operator": "@between", "value": ["2022-07-03T12:00:00+03:00", "2022-07-08T12:00:00+03:00"] }`
  - `@lt` - Date string value,
    Example: `{ "operator": "@lt", "value": "2022-07-03T12:00:00+03:00" }}`
  - `@gte` - Date string value,
    Example: `{ "operator": "@gte", "value": "2022-07-03T12:00:00+03:00" }}`
  - `@today` - boolean value,
    Example: `{ "operator": "@today", "value": true }`

oneOf.title: true
oneOf.description: Supported by `@today`, `@is_before_days`, `@in_past`, `@in_future` operators. Only `true` is acceptable

oneOf.title: Between
oneOf.description: Supported only by `@between` operator in array format `["2024-07-03", "2024-07-10"]`

put.description: Replace the account's custom field definitions. The `customFields` array you send replaces the entire existing set, so any field you omit is removed from the account. type.description:
Additional fee type.
 !!! Not all additional fee types can be synced with channels. If you select the additional fee type which cannot be synced with channels, and 'isSyncToSupportedChannelsEnabled' is [true] you will receive a validation error. GUESTY_BASIC_TRAVEL_COVERAGE and GUESTY_EXTENDED_TRAVEL_COVERAGE can't be synced with channels. This fee types are relevant only to users who purchased Guesty’s Travel Insurance Product and can only be defined as an upsell for guests to purchase.

value.description:
1. Must be bigger than 0,
2. When 'isPercentage' is 'true' then must be smaller or equal to 100

isPercentage.description: Sets wether 'value' should be a fixed amount or percentage

targetFee.description:
1. The fee to use for the additional fee amount calculation when 'isPercentage' is 'true',

multiplier.description:

2. This is required when 'isPercentage' is 'false'.

isSyncToSupportedChannelsEnabled.description:
1. Sync fee to account or listing settings and all future reservations for supported booking channels. 
 !!! Not all additional fee types can be synced with channels. If you select the additional fee type which cannot be synced with channels, and 'isSyncToSupportedChannelsEnabled' is [true] you will receive a validation error

isAutomated.description:
1. Indicates if there are booking channels in which the additional fee should be added automatically to reservations once the reservation arrives in Guesty,
2. if set to 'true', you must configure at least one of 'allSources', 'automationSources', 'allPlatforms', 'automationPlatforms', 'allRUSources', 'RUSources'

allPlatforms.description:
1. If 'true' then the additional fee will be added to all future reservations in Guesty for all booking channels,
2. can not be 'true' when 'isAutomated' is 'false',
3. can not be 'true' when 'automationPlatforms' is not empty

automationPlatforms.description:
1. Additional fee will be added to future reservations in Guesty for specified booking channels,
2. can not contain values when 'isAutomated' is 'false',
3. can not contain values when 'allPlatforms' is 'true'

allSources.description:
1. if 'true' then the additional fee will be added to all future reservations for all manual sources,
2. can not be 'true' when 'isAutomated' is 'false',
3. can not be 'true' when 'automationSources' is not empty

automationSources.description:
1. additional fee will be added to future reservations in Guesty for specified manual sources,
2. can not contain values when 'isAutomated' is 'false',
3. can not contain values when 'allSources' is 'true'

allRUSources.description:
1. If 'true' then the additional fee will be added to all future rentals united reservations in Guesty for all rentals united booking channels,
2. can not be 'true' when 'isAutomated' is 'false'
3. can not be 'true' when 'RUSources' is not empty,
4. when 'true' then 'rentalsUnited' must be included in 'automationPlatforms' or 'allPlatforms' must be 'true'

RUSources.description:
1. Additional fee will be added to future rentals united reservations in Guesty for specified rentals united booking channels, 
2. can not contain values when 'isAutomated' is 'false',
3. can not contain values when 'allRUSources' is 'true',
4. when not empty then 'rentalsUnited' must be included in 'automationPlatforms' or 'allPlatforms' must be 'true'

get.description:
Use this endpoint to retrieve daily calendar availability and pricing for a given listing ID and date range with optimized response format.

**View Parameter Behavior:**
- `view=compact` (default): Returns minimal data without `blockIds` array and detailed `blocks` object for better performance
- `view=full`: Returns complete data including `blockIds` array for each calendar day and detailed `blocks` object with full block information

IMPORTANT: Multi-unit calendar availability is determined by unit allotment, not its `status` field. To calculate if a multi-unit has availability, use the following formula:

```
const isAvailable = _.isNumber(currentDay.allotment)?
currentDay.allotment > 0 : currentDay.status === 'available';
```

put.description: Upsert replaces stored listing-default `cleaningFee` only when `cleaningFee` is sent; omitting it keeps the stored default. This PUT cannot clear only the listing default while keeping overrides — use DELETE on the listing to remove all basic fees for that listing. `channelConfigurations` is required: send `[]` to store no overrides (clears existing). Omitting `channelConfigurations` is 400. An override entry may omit `cleaningFee` (channel only); GET by channel then falls back to the listing default. Do not send `_id` or `lastUpdated` on write; they are server-owned. When `shouldUpdateSubUnits` is true, child listings are overwritten with the same payload (not a merge of each child's previous settings).

put.description:
[Beta] Sets a custom channel commission amount on a reservation and updates the folio.

Send the new `amount` in the reservation currency and `realizationDates` for when it should be recognized.

Realization-date rules:
- Dates are evaluated in the **listing timezone**.
- The **allowed recognition window** is the inclusive `from`/`to` range returned by Guesty Accounting™ for this reservation’s channel-commission (`CM`) line item (`allowedRanges[0]`). It is reservation-specific (driven by the account’s accounting / business-model recognition rules). This API does not return the window; a `date` or both ends of a `from`/`to` range (after normalization) must fall inside it, or the request returns 400 (`realization date not in allowed dates range`).
- For `from`/`to`, the range must also match the stay: before or on check-in use check-in→checkout; during the stay use today→checkout. There must be enough days left before checkout. The stored end date is normalized to checkout minus one day.

Not allowed when the channel has already deducted the commission from the host payout (a prededucted host channel fee is already on the folio — common for Booking.com). In that case the request returns 400.

realizationDates.description: When this channel commission should be recognized for accounting. Send exactly one of the two shapes: `{ date }`, or `{ from, to }` (not both styles, and not an empty object). Invalid or empty values return 400. Example range: `{ "from": "2026-01-01", "to": "2026-01-10" }`.

date.description: Single date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) when the channel commission should be recognized for accounting. Evaluated in the listing timezone; must fall inside the allowed recognition window for this reservation.

from.description: Start date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) of the recognition range. Required together with `to`. Evaluated in the listing timezone; must fall inside the allowed recognition window for this reservation.

to.description: End date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) of the recognition range. Required together with `from`. Evaluated in the listing timezone; must fall inside the allowed recognition window for this reservation.

amount.description: New channel commission amount in the reservation currency (for example USD or EUR). There is no separate currency field — send the amount already in that currency.

200.description: The recalculated reservation folio after the channel commission change. The response body is the full folio; the schema below documents the fields most relevant to this operation (`reservationId`, `currency`, `hostServiceFee`, and related tax fields when present).

currency.description: Reservation currency (ISO 4217). All amounts in the response use this currency.

hostServiceFee.description: Channel commission amount after the override, in the reservation currency.

hostServiceFeeTax.description: Tax on the channel commission, when applicable, in the reservation currency.

hostServiceFeeIncTax.description: Channel commission including tax, when applicable, in the reservation currency.

400.description: The request is invalid. Common causes: missing or invalid `amount` or `realizationDates` (including an empty object, both `date` and `from`/`to`, or only one of `from`/`to`), invalid `reservationId`, a prededucted host channel fee already exists on the reservation, the date/range is outside Accounting’s allowed recognition window for `CM` on this reservation, or a `from`/`to` range does not match the stay rules / has insufficient days before checkout.

404.description: No folio was found for the given `reservationId`.

Get guest code data for reservations with future check-out times, by reservation ID.
      Note: The main guest codes are codes with "purpose" set to "GUEST".
      Codes with "purpose" set to "GUEST_BACKUP" are codes to share with guests in case the "GUEST" code has errors, starting from the check-in day.

get.description:
Retrieves invoice items for one or more reservations.

**Field selection**

You must specify at least one field to return via the `fields` query parameter. `id` is always included on every invoice item and `reservationId` and `currency` are always included at the result level — none of these need to be listed in `fields`. Use the exact enum values listed — any unrecognized field name results in a 400 error.

Nested fields must be requested using their full dot-notation path. The parent name alone (e.g. `adjustments`) is not a valid selection; you must specify the leaf fields you need (e.g. `adjustments.amount`, `adjustments.type`).

A field listed in `fields` may still be absent from a given invoice item when no value is stored for that item. For example, `description`, `logs`, and `realizationDates` are omitted rather than returned as `null` when not set. Scalar arrays such as `adjustments` and `nightsBreakdown` may be omitted or empty depending on the item type and data. See each field's description for details on when it may be absent.

**Response structure**

Each result groups all invoice items for one reservation under a `reservationId` key and includes the reservation `currency`. The `invoiceItems` array contains one entry per invoice item on that reservation, with only the requested fields populated. An empty `invoiceItems` array means the reservation exists but has no invoice items. Results order and invoice item ordering within the array is not guaranteed.

**Currency and monetary amounts**

All monetary fields (`totalPrice`, `nightsSubtotal`, `adjustments.amount`, `nightsBreakdown.basePrice`, etc.) are in the ISO 4217 currency returned in the top-level `currency` field for that reservation. Values are returned with full precision as stored; no additional rounding is applied by this endpoint. Tax treatment follows the channel and reservation configuration and is reflected in the stored amounts.

Monetary fields on the same invoice item do not necessarily reconcile arithmetically. For example, `totalPrice` is the final stored amount after all adjustments, while `nightsSubtotal` is the sum of per-night prices before adjustments — these will differ whenever adjustments exist. Tax treatment, deductions (`isDeducted`, `isDeductedV2`), and account-level configuration each affect stored amounts independently. Treat each field as the authoritative figure for its own semantic rather than attempting to derive one field's value from another.

**Partial success**

A reservation ID is placed in `notFound` when the reservation does not exist.

The response always returns HTTP 200. Found records appear in `results`; unavailable IDs are listed in `notFound`.

**Batching**

A maximum of **200 reservation IDs** can be submitted per request. For larger datasets, split reservation IDs into batches of up to 200 and call this endpoint once per batch.

**Example usage**

Fetch the line item type, total price, and per-night breakdown for two reservations:
```
GET /v1/guest-folio/invoice-items?reservationIds=64a1f2c3e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6,64a1f2c3e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f7&fields=normalType,totalPrice,nightsBreakdown.date,nightsBreakdown.basePrice
```

parameters.name: reservationIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated reservation IDs (for example `64a1f2c3e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6,64a1f2c3e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f7`). Maximum 200 per request.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated field names to include in each invoice item in the response (for example `normalType,totalPrice,nightsBreakdown.date,nightsBreakdown.basePrice`). Must specify at least one. `id` is always returned on each invoice item and `reservationId`/`currency` are always returned at the result level — none need to be listed here. Unrecognized values result in HTTP 400. Nested array fields (e.g. `adjustments`, `nightsBreakdown`) must be requested using their leaf paths (e.g. `adjustments.amount`, `nightsBreakdown.date`) — the parent name alone is not a valid selection. A requested field may be absent from an item when no value is stored for it. For a description of each field and its presence conditions, see the **Response Body** section on this page.

200.description: Invoice items grouped by reservation for each reservation ID that was found. Results order is not guaranteed. Each result contains only the fields requested via `fields`, plus `id` on every invoice item, and `reservationId`/`currency` at the group level. Reservation IDs that were not found are listed in `notFound`.

results.description: One entry per reservation ID that was found. Results are returned in the same order as the input `reservationIds`. Each entry contains `reservationId`, `currency`, and the `invoiceItems` array (empty when no items exist for that reservation).

reservationId.description: The reservation ID these invoice items belong to. Always returned regardless of the fields requested.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this reservation (e.g. `USD`, `EUR`, `GBP`). Monetary fields (`totalPrice`, `nightsSubtotal`, `adjustments.amount`, `nightsBreakdown.basePrice`, etc.) are stored and returned in this currency with full precision as stored; no additional rounding is applied by this endpoint. Always returned regardless of the fields requested.

invoiceItems.description: All invoice items for this reservation. Each item contains only the fields that were requested via the `fields` query parameter, plus `id` which is always included. An empty array means the reservation has no invoice items.

id.description: Unique identifier for this invoice item on the reservation folio. Always returned on every invoice item, regardless of the fields requested.

normalType.description:
Code for the type of charge on the guest folio. Treat this schema’s `enum` as the source of truth for codes returned by this endpoint — it includes `ADF` and `OT`. Do not rely on the Valid Enumerations guide’s Invoice Items table for completeness (that guide may omit `ADF` / `OT` and may link deprecated invoice-items v1 docs).

Common examples: `AF` (accommodation fare), `CF` (cleaning fee), `CT` (city tax), `AFE` (additional fee), `MARF` (markup on fees).

You may also see:
- `AFD` — accommodation fare discount
- `AFA` — accommodation fare adjustment
- `EPF` — extra person fee
- `ADF` — additional discount line
- `OTHER` — other non-tax charge
- `OT` — other tax (not the same as `OTHER`, which is not a tax; also not the same as `TAX`, another code used for an other/generic tax)

See the enum for the full list of possible codes.

origin.description: Indicates how this line item was created. `MANUAL` — entered by a user. `AUTOMATIC` — generated by Guesty business logic. `CHANNEL` — received from the booking channel (e.g. Airbnb, Booking.com).

title.description: Display name for this line item as shown on the guest folio.

description.description: Additional notes or details for this line item.

secondIdentifier.description: Sub-type for line items that have multiple variants. For example, an additional fee (`AFE`) may have a sub-type of `INTERNET` or `PARKING`.

totalPrice.description: Final total amount for this line item, including all nightly amounts and any adjustments. Stored and returned in the reservation currency (see parent `currency` field) with full precision as stored; no additional rounding is applied by this endpoint.

nightsSubtotal.description: Total of the nightly amounts before any adjustments are applied. Stored and returned in the reservation currency with full precision as stored.

isDeducted.description: Whether this line item is deducted from the accommodation fare. When true, this item's amount was reduced from the accommodation fare.

isDeductedV2.description: Whether this item's amount was reduced from the accommodation fare under the updated deduction logic (v2).

stayIndex.description: Zero-based index identifying which stay segment this item belongs to. Relevant for mid-stay reservations where the guest changes units during their stay.

listingId.description: ID of the listing (property unit) this line item is associated with.

realizationDates.description: Date range over which this line item is financially recognized for accounting purposes. Each entry defines a period with a start date and an optional end date. Omitted when no realization dates are configured for this item. Use dot notation to request individual sub-fields: `realizationDates.date`, `realizationDates.to`.

date.description: Start date of the realization period, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

to.description: End date of the realization period, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Absent for single-date realizations.

markupBreakdown.description: Markup breakdown for line items of type `MARF` (markup on fees). Each entry describes one fee that this markup was applied to, including the fee type and the markup amount. Only present on items of type `MARF`; omitted on all other item types even when requested. Use dot notation to request individual sub-fields: `markupBreakdown.invoiceItemId`, `markupBreakdown.amount`, etc.

invoiceItemId.description: ID of the fee invoice item this markup entry is calculated on.

normalType.description: Line item type code of the fee this markup is applied to (e.g. `AFE` for additional fee, `CF` for cleaning fee).

secondIdentifier.description: Sub-type of the fee this markup is applied to.

amount.description: The markup amount applied to this fee. Stored and returned in the reservation currency with full precision as stored.

logs.description: Audit log timestamps and authorship for this line item. Omitted when no audit log data is stored for this item. Use dot notation to request individual sub-fields: `logs.createdAt`, `logs.updatedAt`, `logs.createdBy`, `logs.updatedBy`.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this invoice item was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to this invoice item, in ISO 8601 format.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created this invoice item.

updatedBy.description: The user or system that last updated this invoice item.

nightsBreakdown.description: Per-night price breakdown for this line item, showing the base price for each night of the stay. Omitted when the item has no stored nightly breakdown (e.g. flat-fee items with a single total and no per-night prices). Use dot notation to request individual sub-fields: `nightsBreakdown.date`, `nightsBreakdown.basePrice`.

date.description: The calendar date for this nightly price entry, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

basePrice.description: The base price amount for this specific night. Stored and returned in the reservation currency (see parent `currency` field) with full precision as stored; no additional rounding is applied by this endpoint.

adjustments.description: Price adjustments applied to this line item beyond the base channel price. Each entry describes one adjustment with its amount, type, creator, and an optional per-night breakdown. Returned as an empty array `[]` when the item has no adjustments. Omitted entirely when `adjustments.*` fields are not included in the `fields` request parameter. Use dot notation to request individual sub-fields: `adjustments.amount`, `adjustments.type`, `adjustments.nightsBreakdown.date`, etc.

amount.description: Total adjustment amount. Negative values represent reductions. Stored and returned in the reservation currency (see parent `currency` field) with full precision as stored; no additional rounding is applied by this endpoint.

type.description: Adjustment type. `TOTAL_AMOUNT` adds a flat amount on top of the line item total. `NIGHTLY_RATE` is created when a reservation change affects an item whose nightly amounts are already locked by accounting — the difference is spread across individual nights rather than changing the original nightly prices.

userName.description: The user or system that created this adjustment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this adjustment was created, in ISO 8601 format.

description.description: Human-readable reason or label for this adjustment.

nightsBreakdown.description: Per-night breakdown of this adjustment. Present when `type` is `NIGHTLY_RATE`; each entry shows the adjustment amount for one night. Omitted on `TOTAL_AMOUNT` adjustments.

date.description: The calendar date for this nightly adjustment entry, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

basePrice.description: The adjustment amount applied to this specific night. Stored and returned in the reservation currency with full precision as stored.

notFound.description: Reservation IDs from the request for which no data was found. The request returns HTTP 200 even when some or all IDs are not found.

400.description: The request is invalid. Common causes: missing or empty `reservationIds`, more than 200 reservation IDs submitted, missing or empty `fields`, or an unrecognized field name in `fields`.

message.description: One or more validation failure messages, one per invalid field/value.
example: each value in fields must be one of the following values: normalType, totalPrice, ...
reservationIds must contain at least 1 elements

get.description:
Retrieves a financial overview for one or more reservations from the guest folio.

**Field selection**

You must specify at least one field to return via the `fields` query parameter. `reservationId` is always included in every result, even if not listed in `fields`. Use the exact enum values listed — any unrecognized field name results in a 400 error.

**Partial success**

If some reservation IDs are not found, the response still returns HTTP 200. Found records appear in `results`; missing IDs are listed in `notFound`.

**Bulk limit**

A maximum of **200 reservation IDs** can be submitted per request. For larger datasets, paginate by calling this endpoint in batches of up to 200. Parallel requests are supported and recommended when retrieving many reservations.

**Currency**

Unless the field name explicitly indicates another currency (e.g. `hostPayoutUsd`), monetary values are expressed in the reservation's native currency. Use the `currency` field to determine which currency applies.

**Example usage**

Fetch the host payout and total taxes for two reservations:
```
GET /v1/guest-folio/overview?reservationIds=64a1f2c3e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6,64a1f2c3e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f7&fields=hostPayout,totalTaxes,currency
```

parameters.name: reservationIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated reservation IDs (for example `64a1f2c3e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6,64a1f2c3e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f7`). Maximum 200 per request.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated field names to include in the response (for example `hostPayout,currency,totalTaxes`). Must specify at least one. `reservationId` is always returned. Unrecognized values result in HTTP 400. Nested array fields (e.g. `bundledFees`, `perStayTotals`) must be requested using their leaf paths (e.g. `bundledFees.title`, `perStayTotals.hostPayout`) — the parent name alone is not a valid selection. For a description of each field, see the **Response Body** section on this page.

200.description: Folio overview data for the requested reservations. Only the requested fields are returned per result. Reservation IDs that were not found are listed in `notFound`.

results.description: List of folio overview objects for each reservation ID that was found. Each object contains only the fields that were requested via the `fields` query parameter, plus `reservationId` which is always included.

reservationId.description: The reservation ID this folio belongs to. Always returned regardless of the fields requested.

groupReservationId.description: ID of the parent group reservation. Present only for reservations that are part of a multi-unit group booking.

listingId.description: ID of the listing (property unit) this financial record belongs to.

accountId.description: ID of the property manager account that owns this record.

source.description: Source identifier for this reservation.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this folio.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this folio record was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to this folio record, in ISO 8601 format.

canceledAt.description: Timestamp when this folio was canceled, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the reservation has not been canceled.

rawAccommodationFare.description: Raw accommodation fare received from the booking channel or calculated in guesty before any markup extraction, fee deductions or adjustments, including any inclusive taxes.

accommodationFareNet.description: Net accommodation fare after all discounts, promotions, markups, extra-person fees, fee deductions, adjustments, and inclusive tax extractions have been applied.

accommodationFareIncTax.description: Net accommodation fare including all taxes that apply to it. Null when line-item tax calculation is not enabled for the account or reservation.

get.description:
View the tax, fee, commission, and currency conversion settings that were used to calculate each reservation's financials for every stay. These settings reflect what was applied **at the time of calculation**, which may differ from your current account or listing setup.

### Field selection

Choose at least one field to return using the `fields` query parameter. `reservationId` and `stayIndex` are always included; you do not need to request them. For nested fields like `taxes`, `additionalFees`, or `additionalFees.upsell`, specify the leaf path you want, such as `taxes.name`, `additionalFees.value`, or `additionalFees.upsell.description`. Only `channelCommission`, `cleaningFeeConfig`, `markup`, and `currencyConversion` can be requested by name. If you enter an unrecognized field, you'll receive a 400 error.

### Multi-stay

If a reservation includes multiple stays, you'll see a separate snapshot for each one, each having its own `stayIndex`. For single-stay reservations, the `stayIndex` is 0.

### Response structure

All snapshots for a reservation are grouped under `settingsSnapshots` and sorted by `stayIndex` in ascending order (from lowest to highest).

### Partial success

If a reservation ID is malformed or doesn't exist, it will appear in the `notFound` list. The response always returns HTTP 200.

### Currency

All amounts are shown in the reservation's currency. The `currencyConversion` field shows the exchange rate used **at the time of calculation**.

### Presence

If a field has no stored value, it will be omitted from the response. For older OTA reservations, like Airbnb or Vrbo bookings made before channel commission breakdowns were tracked, `channelCommission` will not appear. Manual-platform reservations are not affected.

### Batching

For large datasets, you can submit up to 200 reservation IDs per request.

### Example request

```shell
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://open-api.guesty.com/v1/guest-folio/settings-snapshot?reservationIds=64a1f2c3e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6&fields=taxes.name%2Ctaxes.amount%2CcurrencyConversion' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>'
```

Must specify at least one. `reservationId` (result level) and `stayIndex` (per snapshot) are always returned. Nested array fields must be requested using their leaf paths. When you export your Guesty calendar to an external service, 
    the events from the Guesty calendar will block the external calendar. 
    You must create an exported calendar entity to export data from Guesty via the iCalendar link. 
    This entity stores the settings used during the export process, such as the URL, state, and adjustments.
    Once the entity is created, the export sync process will be triggered. 
    Please note that you can only have one exported calendar per listing. 
    After posting your request, you will receive an exported calendar descriptor, which includes the URL property. 
    You will use this URL in your other services to pull data from Guesty.

post.description:
Adds an invoice item to the reservation's folio and returns the updated folio.

Use this when you need to add a one-off charge (for example an additional fee, cleaning fee, or tax) to an existing reservation. The folio is recalculated after the item is added.

Common 400 causes: invalid or missing body fields; `secondIdentifier` required for `normalType` `AFE` and forbidden otherwise; `isUpsellFee` only allowed when `normalType` is `AFE`; on multi-stay reservations `stayIndex` is required and must be in range (cleaning fee `CF` only on stay `0`); a once-only normal type already exists on the reservation (or stay); invalid realization dates.

title.description: Title of the invoice item

amount.description: Amount to charge for the invoice item, in the reservation currency (ISO 4217, for example USD or EUR). There is no separate currency field — the server uses the reservation folio currency.

description.example: Late checkout fee for the guest

secondIdentifier.description: When normalType AFE (Additional Fee) is selected, secondIdentifier is required, else it's forbidden. Second identifier is the type of the additional fee

normalType.description: Invoice item type identifier. Read more about valid enums here

realizationDates.description: The date in which the invoice item fee is to be realized. If not provided, the system sets a default based on the earliest available date.

date.description: The date in which the invoice item fee is to be realized. Provide if you want to set a single date for the realization date. Allowed only if "from" and "to" are not provided.

from.description: The start date of the realization date range. Provide if you want to set a range for the realization dates, If you provide the "from" date, you must provide the "to" date.

to.description: The end date of the realization date range. Provide if you want to set a range for the realization dates, If you provide the "to" date, you must provide the "from" date.

stayIndex.description:
Which stay this charge belongs to when a guest changes units during one reservation (`0` = first stay, `1` = second, and so on).

- **Single-stay** (folio has no mid-stay `perStayTotals`): omit `stayIndex`. If sent, it is ignored and not stored.
- **Multi-stay** (folio has `perStayTotals`): `stayIndex` is **required**. Omitting it returns 400 (`Stay index is required when perStayTotals is present`). An index outside the stay count returns 400.
- **Cleaning fee (`CF`)** on multi-stay: only `stayIndex` `0` is allowed; any other stay returns 400 (`Cleaning fee can only be added to the first stay (stayIndex 0)`).
- **Discovery**: read Guest Folio overview `perStayTotals` (each element’s `stayIndex`) to see whether the reservation is multi-stay and which indexes are valid; existing lines also expose `stayIndex` on GET `/guest-folio/invoice-items` when present.

isUpsellFee.description: When `true`, marks this invoice item as an upsell fee (sold after booking). Only allowed when `normalType` is `AFE`; any other normal type returns 400.

201.description: The updated folio with the new invoice item

400.description: The request is invalid. Common causes: invalid or missing body fields; `secondIdentifier` required for `normalType` `AFE` and forbidden otherwise; `isUpsellFee` only when `normalType` is `AFE`; multi-stay `stayIndex` missing/out of range or cleaning fee not on stay `0`; once-only normal type already present; invalid realization dates.

403.description: Permission denied. The caller lacks financials access to the reservation's listing (`validatePermissions` returns 403 with message "Permission denied.").

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Offset: number of matching statements to skip before returning results. Echoed in the response `skip` field. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Requested page size (1–100). Values above the max are clamped. Echoed as the effective page size in the response `limit` field. Defaults to 25.

parameters.name: ownerId
parameters.description: Filter results to a specific owner by their ID

parameters.name: periodMode
parameters.description:
How to interpret period filter fields.
- When omitted and no period fields are sent: no period filter is applied; statements are returned across all periods (subject to other filters and pagination).
- When omitted but any period field is sent (e.g. `year=2025` without `periodMode`): the request is rejected with **400 Bad Request** (`periodMode is required when period fields are provided`). There is no implicit mode and period fields are not ignored in that case.
- When set: only the fields required by that mode are used; other period fields are ignored.
Modes:
- `month` — requires `year` + `month` (e.g. January 2025)
- `year` — requires `year` (full calendar year)
- `monthRange` — requires `fromYear`, `fromMonth`, `toYear`, `toMonth` (start ≤ end)
- `yearRange` — requires `fromYear` + `toYear` (full years inclusive, fromYear ≤ toYear)
- `fiscalYear` — requires `fiscalYear` (uses account fiscal start month)
- `fiscalYearRange` — requires `fromFiscalYear` + `toFiscalYear` (fromFiscalYear ≤ toFiscalYear)

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Calendar year. Required for periodMode=month and periodMode=year.

parameters.name: fromYear
parameters.description: Range start year. Required for periodMode=monthRange and periodMode=yearRange.

parameters.name: fromMonth
parameters.description: Range start month 1–12. Required for periodMode=monthRange.

parameters.name: toYear
parameters.description: Range end year. Required for periodMode=monthRange and periodMode=yearRange.

parameters.name: toMonth
parameters.description: Range end month 1–12. Required for periodMode=monthRange.

parameters.name: fromFiscalYear
parameters.description: Fiscal range start. Required for periodMode=fiscalYearRange.

parameters.name: toFiscalYear
parameters.description: Fiscal range end. Required for periodMode=fiscalYearRange.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Return statements created or updated after this ISO-8601 timestamp. Highly recommended for incremental sync.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by lifecycle status. Repeat the query param to match any of the given values (e.g. `status=APPROVED&status=PENDING`).

parameters.name: sharedVia
parameters.description: Filter by sharing channel. Repeat the query param to match statements shared via any given channel (e.g. `sharedVia=EMAIL&sharedVia=OWNERS_PORTAL`).

parameters.name: listingId
parameters.description: Filter to statements covering the given listing ID(s). Repeat the query param for multiple listings.

parameters.name: businessModelId
parameters.description: Filter to statements under the given business model ID(s). Repeat the query param for multiple business models.

parameters.name: generatedAtFrom
parameters.description: Return statements with `generatedAt` on or after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: generatedAtTo
parameters.description: Return statements with `generatedAt` on or before this ISO-8601 timestamp.

get.summary: Get transactions from Guesty Pay providers
get.description:
The endpoint retrieves transaction data from Guesty Pay providers
      The endpoint supports filtering by:
        - date range (startDate and endDate)
        - reservation confirmation code
        - subAccountId
      However, you can not use the reservationConfirmationCode filter together with other filters.

      The date range filter is mandatory if you do not use the reservationConfirmationCode filter.

parameters.description: Return data for a specific sub account. The format should be accountId.subAccountId.

parameters.name: reservationConfirmationCode
parameters.description: Reservation confirmation code. This filter cannot be used together with other filters.

transactionId.description: Unique identifier for this transaction from the payment processor.

amount.description: Transaction amount in decimal format.

currency.description: ISO currency code of the transaction.

last4.description: Last four digits of the card used in the transaction.

merchantDate.description: Transaction processing date and time by the merchant.

bin.description: Bank identification number (BIN) of the card.

subAccount.description: Payment processor account identifier - merchant account name.

processorARN.description: Acquirer reference number returned by the processor.

dynamicDescriptor.description: Dynamic descriptor sent to the processor.

authorizationOrErrorCode.description: Authorization code or error code returned by the processor.

example: Date range or reservation confirmation code is required

subAccountId must be in the format number.number

get.description: Returns every payment on the given reservation, including authorization holds and their capture payments, plus reservation payment summary fields.

200.description: The reservation payments and payment summary

paymentMethodId.description: Guesty payment method id used for this payment

paymentMethodStatus.description: Status of the payment method at the time of the payment

status.description: Payment status. `PENDING` is not yet charged, including a future schedule. `PENDING_AUTH` is waiting for the guest to complete authentication. `PROCESSING` is accepted by the processor and not settled yet. `SUCCEEDED` is charged. `FAILED` is a processor decline. `CANCELLED` was cancelled before it was charged. `AUTHORIZATION_HOLD_SUCCEEDED` is an authorization hold. `SECURITY_DEPOSIT_SUCCEEDED` is a security deposit hold. `ERROR` cannot be charged.

amount.description: Payment amount, in the reservation currency

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the reservation

isAuthorizationHold.description: When true, this payment is an authorization hold rather than a charge. Cannot be true together with `isSecurityDeposit`. A non-deposit hold is captured with `POST /payments/{paymentId}/capture`.

isSecurityDeposit.description: When true, this payment is a security deposit authorization hold. It requires `releaseAuthorizationHold`, released at `releaseAuthorizationHold.shouldTriggerAt`. Cannot be true together with `isAuthorizationHold`.

type.description: Set when this payment is a refundable deposit. Omitted otherwise.

confirmationCode.description: On a processor payment, the processor payment-intent id (for example `pi_3UITWaE5puWDpHmg1fPNH1ZL`). On a recorded payment, the booking confirmation code sent when the payment was recorded (for example `GY-123456`).

shouldBePaidAt.description: When the payment is scheduled. On a processor payment, a past value means it was charged immediately. On a recorded payment, a past value means it was recorded immediately (`SUCCEEDED`); a future value means `PENDING`. Format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

cancelledAt.description: When the payment was cancelled. Format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

createdAt.description: When the payment record was created. Format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

updatedAt.description: When the payment record was last updated. Format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

receiptId.description: Receipt number generated after a successful charge

error.description: Guesty payment error key when the payment failed. Processor details are in `processorError`.

processorError.description: Processor error details when the payment failed

authenticationRequiredData.description: 3DS / authentication challenge data when guest authentication is required

lastAuthMsgSentDate.description: When the last authentication message was sent. Format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

authenticationUrl.description: URL the guest must open to complete payment authentication (e.g. 3DS)

captureAuthorizationHold.description: Scheduled capture plan for an authorization hold. Created only by payments automation. A manual payment cannot have this plan.

amount.description: Amount scheduled for capture, in the reservation currency. Release plans always release the full hold.

status.description: Status of the scheduled authorization-hold action

shouldTriggerAt.description: When the scheduled capture or release should run. Format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

cancelledAt.description: When the scheduled action was cancelled. Format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

Cancels a payment in status `PENDING` or `PENDING_AUTH`, or a succeeded recorded payment. A payment that already has refunds cannot be cancelled.

Replaces the deprecated [Cancel a pending or recorded payment](https://open-api-docs.guesty.com/reference/reservationsv2paymentcancelupdate) and cancelling through `PUT /reservations/{id}/payments/{paymentId}`.

get.description:

Check out our [Help Center](https://help.guesty.com/hc/en-gb/articles/33014581967901-Pilot-Managing-combo-properties-and-property-variants) to learn more about these property types.

get.description:
Search reservations with flexible filtering, sorting and pagination.

## Filters

Filters use **bracket notation** in the query string:
- `filter[<field>]=<value>` — shorthand (defaults to `eq`, or implicit `in` when comma-separated).
- `filter[<field>][<operator>]=<value>` — explicit operator.

Multiple operators on the same field are combined with logical AND, e.g. 
`filter[checkIn][gte]=2026-01-01&filter[checkIn][lt]=2026-02-01` returns reservations checking in during January 2026.

### Identifier fields (string equality / set membership)
| Field | Operators | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `eq`, `ne`, `in`, `nin` | Comma-separated value implies `in` |
| `listingId` | `eq`, `in` | Matches `unitId` or `unitTypeId` on the first stay segment |
| `confirmationCode` | `eq`, `in` | Comma-separated value implies `in` |
| `source` | `eq`, `in` | e.g. `airbnb`, `booking.com`, `manual` |

### Date / range fields (operator required)
| Field | Operators | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `checkIn` | `eq`, `gte`, `gt`, `lte`, `lt` | Localized date `YYYY-MM-DD`, e.g. `2026-01-15` |
| `checkOut` | `eq`, `gte`, `gt`, `lte`, `lt` | Localized date `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `createdAt` | `eq`, `gte`, `gt`, `lte`, `lt` | ISO 8601 datetime, e.g. `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z` |

## Sorting

Use the `sort` query parameter. Prefix the field with `-` for descending order.
Allowed fields: `_id`, `checkIn`, `checkOut`, `createdAt`. Default: `-_id`.

## Pagination

Use `skip` (default `0`) and `limit` (default `25`, max `100`). The response includes a `pagination.hasMore` flag.

uploadedAt.description: Timestamp of when the reservation was imported via the reservations-upload feature. Only present for reservations created through that flow.

unifiedId.description: Cross-reservation identifier used by unified-booking flows (e.g. linking sibling reservations on the same booking). Only present when set.

channelMetadata.description: Channel-specific metadata for the reservation. Present only for reservations originated from an OTA/channel (e.g. Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, hotel chains). Absent for direct, manual, and website reservations. Carries the channel-side ids (`externalReservationId`, `externalListingId`), lifecycle timestamps (`createdAt`, `confirmedAt`, `updatedAt`, `canceledAt`), rate-plan and cancellation-terms info, channel-specific flags (`isGroupReservation`, `loyaltyProgram`, …), and `guestPreferences` (also channel-sourced).

guestPreferences.description: Guest-supplied preferences for the stay (e.g. smoking). Sourced from the channel reservation payload (e.g. Booking.com). Only present when at least one preference has been recorded on the reservation.

stay.description: Full stay array. Always present — for single-stay reservations it contains exactly one element (mirroring the top-level fields); for mid-stay reservations it contains every segment in chronological order. Each segment carries its own `listingId` / `parentListingId` derived with the same rule as the top-level fields, so callers do not need to re-apply it.

listingId.description: Assigned listing id for this stay segment (= unitId ?? unitTypeId). Matches UnitTypeMapper.mapUnitTypeToListingId.

parentListingId.description: Parent MTL id for this segment. Present only when the segment is on a Multi-Unit listing (either unassigned or assigned to a child unit). Absent for single-unit listings.

ratePlanId.description: Rate plan id for this stay segment.

checkIn.description: Planned arrival datetime for this segment in UTC (includes the listing check-in time).

checkOut.description: Planned departure datetime for this segment in UTC (includes the listing check-out time).

checkInDateLocalized.description: Local check-in date for this segment (YYYY-MM-DD).

checkOutDateLocalized.description: Local check-out date for this segment (YYYY-MM-DD).

post.description: Create tax configuration with the provided settings.

unitTypeId.description:
1. The unit (listing) id on which the new tax will apply.
2. To apply the tax on account level, leave this field empty.

type.description:
1. The tax type.
2. Multiple taxes of the same type are allowed on the same account/listing level, each represented as a distinct tax entity, but they must have distinct names.
3. All taxes sharing a type must agree on whether they are inclusive: an inclusive tax cannot be mixed with an exclusive tax of the same type.
4. Multiple inclusive taxes can share a type only if each has non-overlapping 'appliedOnFees'; 'appliedToAllFees' cannot be 'true' when more than one tax shares the type.

units.description: Determines whether the tax amount should be treated as a fixed or percentage value

amount.description:
1. the amount of the tax, could be a fixed value or percentage whether units is 'FIXED' or 'PERCENTAGE' respectively.
 2. when 'FIXED' then 'amount' has to be greater then 0
 3. when 'PERCENTAGE' then 'amount' has to be greater then 0 and smaller or equal to 100

quantifier.description: Determines by what factor the tax amount will be multiplied

name.description: The name for the tax, which will be used accross guesty. there can be no two taxes with the same name.

appliedToAllFees.description:
1. Relevant only when the units equals 'PERCENTAGE'
2. When equals 'true', then the tax will be calculated on all fees and 'appliedOnFees' must contain all values

items.description: Relevant only when units is 'PERCENTAGE'. Defines the fee types on which the tax will be calculated. Accepts standard invoice item type codes (e.g. AF for Accommodation Fare, CF for Cleaning Fee) or additional fee type identifiers (e.g. PET, CLEANING, PARKING). TOTAL_PAYOUT_BASED fee values are not allowed.

isAppliedByDefault.description:
1. When set to 'true' and 'appliedByDefaultOnChannels' is not empty, then Guesty will prededuct the tax from the accommodation fare.
 2. can not be 'true' when 'appliedByDefaultOnChannels' is empty

items.description: When provided and isAppliedByDefault is set to true, Guesty will pre-deduct the tax from the accommodation fare for reservations from those channels. Cannot contain values when isAppliedByDefault is false. Only supported for 'airbnb2' and 'manual' channels.

conditionalOverrides.description: Set additional conditions for this tax

viewType.description:
1. The kind of conditions to set on the tax
 2. When 'units' is 'FIXED' and 'quantifier' is 'guest'/'stay' then 'NiGHTS' and 'NIGHTS_IN_DATES' viewTypes are forbidden,
 3. When 'units' is 'PERCENTAGE' then all viewTypes are allowed

rules.description:
1. The dates and nights ranges that the tax condition will apply for.
 2. When viewType is 'LOS' then rules is forbidden, else rules is required and can not be empty.

dateRange.description: 1. When viewType is 'NIGHTS' then rules objects can not contain dateRanges.

from.description: Start of the date range in MM-DD format.

to.description: End of the date range in MM-DD format.

nightRanges.description: 1. When viewType is 'DATES' then all rules objects must contain only 1 nightRange with no 'to' field and 'from' field equals 1.

maxNightCountToApplyOn.description:
1. The tax will be applied for all reservation that has night count smaller then 'maxNightCountToApplyOn'
 2. Only when 'viewType' is 'LOS' then this field is allowed and required

isInclusive.description:
1. When 'true', the tax amount is included in the accommodation fare rather than added on top.
2. Cannot be 'true' together with 'isAppliedByDefault', 'appliedByDefaultOnChannels', or 'conditionalOverrides'.

channelOverrides.description: Channel-specific overrides for this tax. Each entry customizes the tax for a specific channel.

channel.description: The booking channel this override applies to (e.g. Airbnb, Booking.com). Each channel can only appear once per tax.

isEnabled.description: Whether this tax is active for the specified channel. When set to false, the tax will not be applied to reservations from this channel. Defaults to true if not provided.

name.description: A custom display name for this tax on the specified channel. If not provided, the tax's default name is used.

isInclusive.description: Whether the tax should be treated as inclusive for this channel. If not provided, the tax's default inclusive setting is used.

isAppliedByDefault.description: Whether the tax is automatically pre-deducted from the accommodation fare for this channel override. If not provided, the tax's default setting is used. Only allowed when this override's channel is 'airbnb2' or 'manual'. Must be set to true when appliedByDefaultOnChannels is provided.

items.description: When provided and isAppliedByDefault is set to true, Guesty will pre-deduct the tax from the accommodation fare for reservations from those channels. Cannot contain values when isAppliedByDefault is false. Only supported for 'airbnb2' and 'manual' channels.

201.description: The tax has been successfully created.

4. Multiple inclusive taxes can share a type only if each has non-overlapping 'appliedOnFees'; 'appliedToAllFees' cannot be 'true' when more than one tax shares the type.

units.description: Determines whether the tax amount should be treated as a fixed or percentage value

amount.description:
1. the amount of the tax, could be a fixed value or percentage whether units is 'FIXED' or 'PERCENTAGE' respectively.
 2. when 'FIXED' then 'amount' has to be greater then 0
 3. when 'PERCENTAGE' then 'amount' has to be greater then 0 and smaller or equal to 100

quantifier.description: Determines by what factor the tax amount will be multiplied

appliedToAllFees.description:
1. Relevant only when the units equals 'PERCENTAGE'
2. When equals 'true', then the tax will be calculated on all fees and 'appliedOnFees' must contain all values

items.description: Relevant only when units is 'PERCENTAGE'. Defines the fee types on which the tax will be calculated. Accepts standard invoice item type codes (e.g. AF for Accommodation Fare, CF for Cleaning Fee) or additional fee type identifiers (e.g. PET, CLEANING, PARKING). TOTAL_PAYOUT_BASED fee values are not allowed.

isAppliedByDefault.description:
1. When set to 'true' and 'appliedByDefaultOnChannels' is not empty, then Guesty will prededuct the tax from the accommodation fare.
 2. can not be 'true' when 'appliedByDefaultOnChannels' is empty

items.description: When provided and isAppliedByDefault is set to true, Guesty will pre-deduct the tax from the accommodation fare for reservations from those channels. Cannot contain values when isAppliedByDefault is false. Only supported for 'airbnb2' and 'manual' channels.

conditionalOverrides.description: Set additional conditions for this tax

viewType.description:
1. The kind of conditions to set on the tax
 2. When 'units' is 'FIXED' and 'quantifier' is 'guest'/'stay' then 'NiGHTS' and 'NIGHTS_IN_DATES' viewTypes are forbidden,
 3. When 'units' is 'PERCENTAGE' then all viewTypes are allowed

rules.description:
1. The dates and nights ranges that the tax condition will apply for.
 2. When viewType is 'LOS' then rules is forbidden, else rules is required and can not be empty.

dateRange.description: 1. When viewType is 'NIGHTS' then rules objects can not contain dateRanges.

from.description: Start of the date range in MM-DD format.

to.description: End of the date range in MM-DD format.

nightRanges.description: 1. When viewType is 'DATES' then all rules objects must contain only 1 nightRange with no 'to' field and 'from' field equals 1.

maxNightCountToApplyOn.description:
1. The tax will be applied for all reservation that has night count smaller then 'maxNightCountToApplyOn'
 2. Only when 'viewType' is 'LOS' then this field is allowed and required

context.description: Optional preprocessing. Options are `now`, `createdAt`, `confirmedAt`, `canceledAt`, and `alteredAt`. When given, the date in value is relative to the context.

fields.description: Selection of fields, separated by space

sort.description: ascending sort, use '-' for descending sort

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the view was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the view was last updated.

scheduledEmails.description: Scheduled email reports configured for this view.

days.description: Array of numbers 0-6, representing days of the week, where 0 is Sunday and 6 is Saturday

hour.description: when the report should be sent. E.g, 14 (send at 2pm)

shares.description: Contacts this view is shared with.

contactId.description: Required Contact ID to share with

delete.description: Delete one of your account's saved views. You must be the view's owner, or hold permission to manage all views, otherwise the request returns 403. Guesty's predefined views cannot be deleted and return 400. Deleting a view also revokes any report access previously shared from it.

get.description: Retrieve every webhook subscription registered under your account, including the destination URL and the list of events each one is subscribed to.

url.description: The endpoint URL that webhook event payloads are sent to.

events.description: add list of event to register for the provided url. Legacy reservation events (reservation.new, reservation.updated, reservation_update_shortlist) are deprecated and may require temporary allowlist approval.

post.description: Subscribe a destination URL to one or more Guesty events. At least one event is required, and every event name must be one of the supported values — an unrecognized name is rejected with 400. An account may hold up to 100 webhooks.

url.description: The endpoint URL that webhook event payloads are sent to.

get.description: Get the secret for a webhook endpoint
Retrieve a single webhook subscription by its ID, including its destination URL and subscribed events. Only webhooks belonging to your account are returned.

url.description: The endpoint URL that webhook event payloads are sent to.

events.description: add list of event to register for the provided url. Legacy reservation events (reservation.new, reservation.updated, reservation_update_shortlist) are deprecated and may require temporary allowlist approval.

put.description: Replace the set of events a webhook is subscribed to. The destination URL is fixed at creation — sending a different `url` is rejected with 400, so create a new webhook instead. At least one valid event name is required. Returns 204 with no body on success.

delete.description: Permanently remove a webhook subscription, stopping all further event deliveries to its destination URL. Returns 204 whether or not a matching webhook existed under your account.
